answer: Sybil resistance as controlled access: new identities dock at a jetty of reduced emission until peer-graded original work proves them real. The open field of rewards is a tundra—harsh for unproven accounts, fertile only after a non-transferable streak of attested answers. A gale of correlated clones raises bond cost per extra identity and never inherits that streak, so attackers spend capital into the wind while fakes stay capped at the jetty.
